history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity ECOR Number Generate details.
features: ECOR Number Generation function is used to create a unique ECOR number for a container.

events.description: Opens the ECOR Number Generate screen in a new tab
events.triggered_when: User clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "ECOR Number Generate"

events.description: Queries the records matching the query parameters and lists them in the grid, with the count in Total Record(s)
events.triggered_when: User selects the Discharge Voyage and clicks Search

events.description: Clears the query fields and the grid
Selects or deselects all records in the grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks the select-all check box in the grid header

events.description: Selects or deselects the individual record
events.triggered_when: User clicks the check box of a record

events.description: Validates whether ECOR Numbers can be generated for the selected records
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks Check List
events.remarks: "No Errors Found - ECOR Number can be Generated"

events.description: Generates ECOR Numbers for the selected records
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more records and clicks Generate
